control.name: CONTROL — ignore the stop flag (a stopped system still admits agent work)

mutations.name: invert the restriction lattice (moreRestrictive returns the LESS restrictive disposition, so confident advice widens)
let applied advice SET the cap to its label instead of only restricting it (a confident bounded label authorizes)
honour advice while the advice kill switch is set
drop the brief's own gates from the union (the admission disposition alone decides the mandatory nodes)
let a failed readiness check map to supervised-agent (an agent lane) in a valid policy
treat unknown readiness without a discovery grant as a note, not a hold
